supersedes.reason: The first remediation review confirmed complete package authentication, strict handshake validation, retained samples/hardware, nonqualifying measurement-only behavior, and stale-PASS invalidation, but found that evaluation did not enforce the current executing tool/clean state and that transient create/use/delete injection remained possible between inventory checks. This record binds those final provenance and whole-lifecycle immutability controls.

outcome: The exact approved Windows Core sidecar is qualified from a clean Git state by the exact reviewed benchmark tool against an independently hash-pinned raw-sample baseline, while a protected private package tree prevents creation, replacement, deletion, or rename throughout every process lifecycle.

integrationChecks.result: At exact clean state f032cdd, the gate authenticated executing tool SHA-256 09cf988d... against its baseline source commit, recorded the exact current HEAD, verified the approved 644-file/31569506-byte package and SHA identities, then completed the ACL-protected real package benchmark. Readiness p50 833.492 ms, shutdown p95 221.094 ms, and idle working-set p95 62312448 bytes pass both absolute and 20-percent limits. Baseline SHA-256: 76c8eec8dbc22025bf573dfe98c2831e21e9867dba2ca2f5b071d080608515f4. Report SHA-256: 0805764647605cbbd588498c2035a551226161f7df14711a730cd814b682b530.

Eight focused tests pass. In addition to every prior package, handshake, baseline, failure-report, and mutation control, fabricated current tool path/SHA/state values fail evaluation. A real concurrent attacker thread repeatedly attempts transient create/write/delete inside the package while the ACL is active; every attempt is denied, approved bytes remain readable, and write access is restored only after the protected interval.
All 71 governed Python files pass formatting, Ruff, and MyPy; focused Ruff/format/MyPy also pass. Quality report SHA-256: 34bee940096b6a36203cd889edbe110e739194f851bc46a106fca4577a0c5172.

The original exact clean integrated runtime state passed the complete desktop, service, and e2e-local profiles once at slice review. Subsequent changes are limited to the performance qualifier, its focused tests/baseline/hash authority/docs, LF handling for hash authorities, and review/evidence state. No runtime, package bytes/report, dependency, application, native supervisor, UI, API contract, build input, security policy, or profile definition changed. AGENTS.md risk-based selection therefore reruns the hardened real-package qualifier and focused quality checks rather than unchanged 7-11 minute profiles.
All task evidence and approvals remain intact; planning state and generated views are validated after this superseding evidence is attached.

integratedBehavior: The modular local-only Core service, exact self-contained artifact, strict supervised handshake/readiness, atomic Job containment, serialized recovery, and renderer-safe state contract retain their independently approved behavior.

Performance execution is allowed only from a clean tracked Git state with the exact current tool path and SHA matching its reachable baseline source commit. The report binds that current HEAD plus the exact package evidence, report, manifest, entrypoint, contract, inventory count, and byte count.

The private package copy receives an explicit Windows deny-write/create/delete ACL for the current user plus no-delete handles for every known directory and no-write/delete handles for every manifested file. The denial is probed before launch and removed after all lifecycle checks; the manifest is reverified throughout.

The independently hash-pinned baseline retains every raw sample, exact hardware, exact package identity, measurement state/tool commit and bytes, methodology, absolute budgets, and 20-percent limits. Measurement-only and all failures persist explicit nonqualification over any stale report.
Production and development still expose only functional CAP-01 UI; the UI-reference site remains isolated design/conformance material.
